race.comment: QUEEN LOCH (1) caught the eye with a fast early split and setting up a 2.5 lengths win at this track over 300m in 17.51. The form from her last run stacks up well. Great chance to get the job done again. REMISSION RUN (8) was well fancied in betting last start but could only manage 3.5 lengths away in third (17.90). Has performed well from this box with a win and three minor placings to his name from six starts. Hard to beat again. FUN EFFECTS (2) was below best at her last start when 8th at this track following a second place finish (17.67) there two back. Form here at the trip sound including six wins. The form from her last run is stacking up nicely. Warrants plenty of respect. FABIO ZED (7) is a surprise last-start placegetter who should be thereabouts.
